intro: Every one of these is a real Northeast Pennsylvania home or building, finished by our own crew. Full tear-offs and architectural shingles, seamless gutters with leaf guards, siding and soffit, chimney repair and waterproofing, skylights flashed and sealed properly, and EPDM flat roof systems. Two things come up unprompted in our reviews — the price, and the fact that we clean up when we are done. Both are on purpose.
